probe_meta.label: dense-G (controlled retrieval-mechanism swap of Probe G)

response_text:
26. (Currently Amended) A non-transitory machine readable medium storing a program which when executed by at least one processing unit analyzes a document, the program comprising sets of instructions for: receiving a document that comprises a plurality of primitive graphic elements defined separately within the document, the document having a drawing order that indicates the order in which the primitive graphic elements are drawn when the document is displayed; calculating a first value for a first primitive graphic element and a second primitive graphic element that is subsequent to the first in the drawing order, wherein the first value is calculated based on a spatial relationship between the first and second primitive graphic elements; and based on the comparison of the first value to other values calculated for additional primitive graphic elements that are subsequent in the drawing order, defining a single structural graphic element within the document from the first and second primitive graphic elements __only when the first value satisfies a predetermined threshold condition relative to the other values__.

27. (Currently Amended) The non-transitory machine readable medium of claim 26, wherein the first value is a size value __derived from a measurement of spatial proximity between the first and second primitive graphic elements__.

28. (Currently Amended) The non-transitory machine readable medium of claim 26, wherein the first value represents a size of a smallest bounding box that encompasses the first and second primitive graphic elements __and is calculated only when the first and second primitive graphic elements are determined to be adjacent in the drawing order based on a distance metric__.

29. (Currently Amended) The non-transitory machine readable medium of claim 28, wherein the size of the smallest bounding box is calculated as a sum of a width and height of the bounding box divided by a sum of a width and height of a page containing the primitive graphic elements __and the calculation is performed only for primitive graphic elements that satisfy a minimum proximity requirement__.

30. (Currently Amended) The non-transitory machine readable medium of claim 28, wherein the size of the smallest bounding box is calculated as an area of the bounding box divided by an area of a page containing the primitive graphic elements __and the calculation is performed only for primitive graphic elements that satisfy a minimum proximity requirement__.

31. (Currently Amended) The non-transitory machine readable medium of claim 26, wherein the set of instructions for calculating comprises a set of instructions for calculating a different value for each pair of primitive graphic elements subsequent in the drawing order __based on a spatial proximity metric__, wherein the set of instructions for defining the single structural graphic element comprises sets of instructions for: using the calculated values for pairs of primitive graphic elements to identify clusters of primitive graphic elements as candidates for joining as compound graphic elements __by applying a clustering algorithm that groups elements based on proximity thresholds__; and identifying sequences of primitive graphic elements within a cluster whose bounding boxes intersect; and joining the sequences as single graphic elements __only when the intersection satisfies a minimum overlap criterion__.

32. (Currently Amended) A non-transitory machine readable medium storing a program which when executed by at least one processing unit analyzes a document, the program comprising sets of instructions for: receiving a document that comprises a plurality of primitive graphic elements defined separately within the document; based on values calculated for pairs of primitive graphic elements __using a spatial proximity metric__, defining a set of successive primitive graphic elements as a candidate compound graphic element; using bounds of the primitive graphic elements in the cluster to identify one or more subsets of primitive graphic elements within the set __by applying a spatial intersection analysis__; and defining each particular subset having more than one primitive graphic element as a single structural graphic element within the document, the structure graphic element comprising the primitive graphic elements in the particular subset.

33. (Currently Amended) The non-transitory machine readable medium of claim 32, wherein the set of instructions for defining the set of successive primitive graphic elements comprises performing cluster analysis on the calculated values __using a proximity-based clustering algorithm that groups elements based on spatial relationships__.

34. (Currently Amended) The non-transitory machine readable medium of claim 32, wherein the set of instructions for using bounds of the primitive graphic elements in the cluster to identify one or more subsets of primitive graphic elements comprises sets of instructions for: selecting a first graphic element in the cluster and assigning the graphic element to a new sub-cluster; assigning a second graphic element in the cluster to the sub-cluster when a bounding box of the second graphic element overlaps a bounding box of the sub-cluster __by a minimum overlap amount__.

35. (Currently Amended) The non-transitory machine readable medium of claim 34, wherein the set of instructions for using bounds of the primitive graphic elements in the cluster to identify one or more subsets of primitive graphic elements further comprises a set of instructions for assigning a third graphic element to a second sub-cluster when a bounding box of the third graphic element does not overlap the bounding box of the sub-cluster __by at least a minimum threshold distance__.

36. (Currently Amended) The non-transitory machine readable medium of claim 34, wherein the bounding box of the sub-cluster is an intersection of the bounding boxes of all primitive graphic elements already in the sub-cluster __and is recalculated dynamically as new elements are added to the sub-cluster__.

37. 38. 39. 40. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 38, wherein the size of the smallest bounding box is calculated as an area of the bounding box divided by an area of a page containing the primitive graphic elements __and the calculation is performed only for primitive graphic elements that satisfy a minimum proximity requirement__.

41. 46. (Previously Presented) The apparatus of claim 42, wherein the document comprises an unstructured vector graphics document.
